lead.headline: Coinbase Accelerates RWA Dominance via Tokenized Equities
lead.tldr: The convergence of regulated infrastructure and real-world assets (RWA) is accelerating, as Coinbase moves into tokenized stocks while MiCA-compliant tools enter the European market.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Coinbase launching tokenized US stocks, backed 1:1, with holders able to receive dividends
top_signals.summary: Coinbase is launching tokenized US stocks that are backed 1:1 by the underlying assets. This initiative allows holders to receive dividends, positioning Coinbase against rivals like Robinhood and Kraken in the RWA space.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Coinbase is leveraging its retail distribution to bridge the gap between traditional equities and on-chain ownership, intensifying the competition for the RWA layer.

top_signals.title: Australia's High Court backs regulator in Block Earner crypto yield case
top_signals.summary: Australia's High Court has unanimously ruled that Block Earner was required to hold a financial services licence for its crypto yield operations. This decision overturns a previous appeal and reinforces the regulator's authority over crypto-asset service providers in the region.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Australian High Court's ruling underscores the increasing global trend of treating crypto yield products as regulated financial services.

top_signals.title: BitGo Launches MiCA Crypto Infrastructure In Europe
top_signals.summary: BitGo has launched a crypto-as-a-service platform in Europe designed to be compliant with the Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation. The platform provides regulated custody and trading tools to help firms meet the EU's upcoming regulatory deadlines.
top_signals.why_it_matters: BitGo's MiCA-ready infrastructure provides a critical blueprint for institutional entry into the EU, reducing the regulatory friction for custody and trading.

top_signals.title: Senate, House reach agreement on housing bill banning CBDC through 2030
top_signals.summary: The US Senate and House have reached an agreement on housing legislation that includes a ban on the issuance of a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) through 2030. This legislative move signals a significant regulatory hurdle for the potential implementation of a digital dollar.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The US legislative push against CBDCs preserves the opportunity for private-sector stablecoin issuers to dominate the digital dollar landscape.

top_signals.title: Illinois governor approves crypto transaction tax despite industry uproar“There is effectively no comparable state financial transaction tax on stocks, bonds or derivatives anywhere in the country,” said a16z general counsel Miles Jennings.
top_signals.summary: The Governor of Illinois has approved a tax on cryptocurrency transactions, sparking significant backlash from the industry. Critics, including a16z, argue that the tax is discriminatory as no similar transaction tax exists for traditional financial assets like stocks or bonds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Illinois' transaction tax creates a dangerous precedent for discriminatory fiscal policy that could stifle liquidity and institutional adoption at the state level.

deals.summary: MANTRA is being acquired by its previous backer, Inveniam, following a period of instability. The acquisition follows a major collapse of MANTRA's token value in 2025, leading to company restructuring and layoffs.

on_the_radar.title: Trump-backed World Liberty Financial nears OCC approval for federal trust charter: report
on_the_radar.summary: World Liberty Financial, a project backed by Donald Trump, is reportedly close to receiving a federal trust charter from the OCC. This approval would enable the entity to issue and redeem its USD1 stablecoin under a single federal regulator.

on_the_radar.title: Coinbase unveils 'System Update' unlocking an AI advisor, global unified liquidity, options trading and more
on_the_radar.summary: Coinbase has announced a major 'System Update' introducing an AI-powered advisor and a unified liquidity pool for global trading. The update also expands the platform's offerings to include options trading and enhanced user experience features.

on_the_radar.title: State Street, Anchorage Back Fund for Stablecoin Reserves
on_the_radar.summary: State Street Investment Management has launched a new money market fund specifically designed for stablecoin issuers to manage their reserve assets. This move follows similar initiatives by other major financial institutions like JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley, signaling growing institutional adoption of stablecoin infrastructure.

on_the_radar.title: BlackRock launches new Bitcoin ETF that generates income using a covered call strategy
on_the_radar.summary: BlackRock has launched a new Bitcoin ETF (BITA) that utilizes a covered call strategy to generate income. The fund holds Bitcoin and IBIT, selling call options on up to 35% of its holdings to provide yield for investors.

on_the_radar.title: Zama, Morpho and Steakhouse launch first 'confidential DeFi yield' vault on Ethereum
on_the_radar.summary: Zama, Morpho, and Steakhouse have introduced the first confidential DeFi yield vault on the Ethereum network. This development allows institutional firms to earn yield on their assets without exposing their account balances publicly.

on_the_radar.title: US gaming industry groups urge Senate to ban sports prediction markets in crypto bill: report
on_the_radar.summary: US gaming industry groups are lobbying the Senate to prohibit sports and casino-style prediction markets within a proposed crypto market structure bill. This move seeks to restrict the growth of decentralized prediction platforms that compete with traditional gaming operators.

on_the_radar.title: Bipartisan senators push Treasury to uphold states' authorities under the GENIUS Act
on_the_radar.summary: A bipartisan group of U.S. senators is urging the Treasury Department to maintain the authority of individual states to regulate stablecoins. This effort is tied to the GENIUS Act and focuses on balancing federal and state oversight.

on_the_radar.title: Coinbase Adds ACATS Stock Transfers in Push Beyond Crypto
on_the_radar.summary: Coinbase has integrated ACATS stock transfers for its US users, allowing them to move traditional stock portfolios into the platform. This move is part of Coinbase's broader strategy to expand its brokerage offerings to include stocks, ETFs, and other trading products.

linkedin_post:
The RWA narrative is shifting from 'experimental' to 'distribution-led.' Coinbase's move into tokenized US stocks isn't just about a new product; it's about capturing the flow of traditional capital into the on-chain ecosystem. When the largest retail on-ramp integrates dividend-paying equities, the friction between TradFi and DeFi shrinks further.

Simultaneously, we are seeing a divergence in regulation. While Europe builds a clear path via MiCA (as seen with BitGo), US state-level policies—like the new transaction tax in Illinois—threaten to create a fragmented and discriminatory landscape for digital assets.

For founders, the lesson is clear: Infrastructure that solves for compliance and distribution will win the next cycle. The 'move fast and break things' era is being replaced by the 'build compliant and scale' era.

Is the integration of tokenized equities the catalyst needed for the next wave of institutional adoption, or will regulatory fragmentation in the US stall the momentum? #RWA #Web3 #CryptoRegulation #Blockwall
